skills.objective: Operate a governed Category Search System from strategic Query Brain through T1 content execution, neutral multi-surface observations, auditable operational reprioritization, and a Google Sheets dashboard/weekly content queue without fabricating demand or overwriting strategic truth.
skills.trigger: When the user wants to build category authority, define 20-50+ strategic questions, create a search/query map, prioritize content for Google/LinkedIn/AI search, execute T1 content, observe search visibility, or run a weekly Category Search dashboard/queue.
procedure: Frame the category objective with MANGO and normalize canonical entities, audiences, markets and category vocabulary.
Generate and deduplicate distinct search jobs; score strategic priority without inventing search volume, keyword difficulty or ranking probability.
Select a balanced T1 portfolio and define entity association, proof requirements, unique point of view and content mode.
Execute T1 through the Content Engine using materially distinct assets and evidence cards.
Stop at the publish gate before external publication unless explicit authority exists.
Observe exact queries neutrally across authorized search/AI surfaces and record timestamp, provider, target mention, citations, owned citations, entities and bounded answer evidence.
Preserve strategic scores and calculate a separate operational-priority overlay.
Export normalized observation/query/entity/URL feeds to the Google Sheets Dashboard; never mix synthetic DEMO rows with LIVE rows.
Generate the weekly content queue from operational status while keeping strategic rank visible.
Use corrections and repeated observations to refresh evidence, content and operational order; only change strategic Brain definitions when strategic evidence justifies a versioned change.
Retain history/rollback and never treat a single observation as permanent ranking.
rules: The Query Brain is a strategic map, not a claim about actual search volume.
Never guarantee ranking, indexing, AI citation, traffic, leads or sales.
Never invent search volume, keyword difficulty, competitor rankings or AI visibility measurements.
Do not create separate thin assets for trivial wording variations of the same intent.
Prefer unique first-hand, evidence-backed, people-first content over commodity summaries.
One primary search job per asset.
Current platform mechanics and current market claims require fresh verification when web access exists.
Search observations must include date, query, surface and result.
Strategic priority and operational priority are separate; observation must not silently rewrite strategic score.
Measurement prompts must be neutral and must not tell a provider to mention or rank the target entity.
Do not scrape consumer Google pages directly; use authorized/imported SERP observations.
Synthetic DEMO observations must never be presented as real visibility or included in LIVE dashboard calculations.
Share of Answer means target appearances divided by collected observations only; it is not market share.
The Google Sheets dashboard is an operating view, not the source of strategic truth.
External publication requires the publish gate unless the active contract explicitly authorizes it.

output.format: structured markdown + JSON/CSV registry + dashboard feed

definition_of_done: Canonical entities, audience, market and category vocabulary are explicit.
The query universe contains materially distinct search jobs.
Every query has a transparent strategic priority score with no fabricated demand data.
T1 queries have entity association, proof requirement and content mode.
Near-duplicate queries are clustered or merged.
Current factual claims are sourced or marked for verification.
Dated neutral observations remain separate from strategic truth.
Operational priority can be recalculated without modifying the base strategic score.
Google Sheets feed separates DEMO and LIVE data and produces a weekly content queue.
No search outcome is promised.
No external publication occurs without required approval.
qa: No duplicate search jobs as separate thin-content targets.
No priority score described as search volume, difficulty or probability.
T1 queries are strategically or commercially meaningful.
Entity association is natural and supportable.
Observation queries are neutral and surface-specific.
Strategic score is unchanged after observation scoring.
DEMO and LIVE rows are never mixed.
Share of Answer uses collected observations as its denominator.
skills.missing_information_policy: Use the existing Query Brain and explicit positioning as defaults. If demand data, proof, current ranking evidence, provider credentials or SERP observations are missing, mark UNKNOWN/TBD or BLOCKED; do not infer or fabricate.

skills.objective: Create or audit LinkedIn content that strengthens discoverability, entity association, and AI/search retrievability for one defined search job, including direct execution of category-search-system handoff packages, without promising ranking or inventing evidence.
skills.trigger: When a user or parent Category Search System wants to create, optimize, cluster, or audit LinkedIn content around a query, category, problem, geography, service, expertise area, or AI-search visibility goal.
procedure: If invoked from category-search-system, validate and consume the handoff package as the source of truth for query_id, primary query, entity association, audience, geography, angle and evidence requirements.
Frame direct tasks with MANGO when no parent handoff exists.
Classify search intent and keep one primary search job per asset.
Build a compact query map with semantic secondary phrases.
Generate three natural opening lines that front-load the primary topic without keyword stuffing.
Draft the answer so the useful response appears near the top.
Make the relationship between the entity and category explicit using approved evidence.
Verify material claims; remove or qualify unsupported claims.
Handle public-visibility and document/PDF filename risk before previewing URL terms.
Return the requested asset plus handoff receipt, discoverability preview, verification queries, claims-to-verify and publish-gate status.
Stop at the publication gate unless explicit publish authority and approval exist.
rules: Never guarantee ranking, indexing, AI citation, traffic, leads or sales.
Never invent search volume, rankings, testimonials, clients, results or platform mechanics.
Prefer official LinkedIn sources for current platform behavior when web access exists.
Use one primary search job per asset.
Place the topic naturally in the opening line when search-oriented URL construction matters.
Avoid hashtags in the opening line.
Do not assume editing the opening after publication changes the existing URL.
Flag document/PDF filename effects before claiming what the slug will be.
Keep copy useful and natural; no keyword stuffing.
When invoked by category-search-system, do not change the parent's strategic score or silently substitute another primary query.
Publishing requires human approval unless the active contract explicitly authorizes it.
definition_of_done: The primary query and search intent are explicit.
The opening line contains the primary topic naturally.
The entity-topic association is explicit and non-spammy.
The first useful answer appears near the top.
Material claims are supported or clearly qualified.
Public visibility and media filename risks are addressed.
The URL/slug is presented only as a preview, never a guarantee.
Verification queries are supplied.
Parent query_id is returned in the handoff receipt when applicable.
No external publication occurs without the required approval.
qa: Facts, first-hand experience, inference and recommendation are distinguishable.
Document/PDF behavior is handled when applicable.
skills.missing_information_policy: If a parent handoff is present, preserve its query and mark missing evidence/TBD. For direct tasks, derive query candidates only when the topic is clear. Never fabricate demand data, proof, or current platform behavior.

skills.trigger: Después de que el cliente solicita cotización y se reciben precios, cantidades y el perfil aprobado del emisor.
inputs: issuer profile configurado localmente (nombre, razón social, empresa, email, teléfono, domicilio, moneda y reglas fiscales explícitas)
uno o más conceptos con quantity, description, unit, unit_price y tax_codes explícitos
approved_by humano solamente para emisión y folio
sources: Solicitud comercial facilitada por el usuario
Catálogo de impuestos/tasas configurado y fechado por emisor
Políticas y Gates asignados al Employee
procedure: Comprobar registro/asignación de la Skill, autonomía y Gates del Employee.
Guardar una sola vez el perfil del emisor, sin sobrescritura y sin almacenar credenciales.

Aplicar aritmética determinística Decimal: cantidad×precio, descuentos, base, impuestos adicionales, retenciones y total, con ROUND_HALF_UP por renglón.
Aplicar únicamente códigos fiscales explícitos y reglas vigentes del perfil; nunca deducir fiscalidad por el texto de la descripción.
Emitir snapshot inmutable del emisor y la política fiscal aplicados al borrador para evitar cambios retroactivos.
Generar cotización borrador sin folio desde el mismo JSON validado en Markdown/Word/PDF opcional.
Exigir atestación humana con approved_by antes de emitir; generar folio único secuencial por prefijo/año mediante transacción SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
Registrar aprobación declarada, folio y fecha de emisión sin enviar correo ni crear CFDI.
Hacer la emisión idempotente por draft_id; si la renderización falla, recuperar el folio ya asignado sin consumir otro.
Mostrar límites: cotización comercial no es factura; las reglas tributarias requieren revisión profesional.
rules: Nunca usar el modelo de IA para efectuar operaciones monetarias, porcentajes, impuestos o folios.
Rechazar valores float no confiables y números NaN/Infinity; usar Decimal y tasas como texto.
No asumir tasas, exenciones, retenciones, regímenes fiscales ni currency conversion; códigos de impuestos explícitos por renglón.
Los precios y condiciones comerciales proceden de la solicitud aprobada; nunca inventarlos.
No emitir sin --approved-by, y advertir que es autoatestación local, no identidad autenticada.
No sobrescribir perfiles, borradores ni documentos previamente emitidos.
No enviar al cliente, facturar CFDI ni generar obligaciones fiscales automáticamente.
No prometer plazos o cambiar alcance sin autorización humana cuando corresponda.

definition_of_done: Perfil de emisor completo y persistido sin sobrescribir.
Borrador calculado por Decimal con impuestos explícitos y totales recomputables.
Los importes coinciden en JSON, Markdown, Word y PDF desde un mismo snapshot.
Los folios nunca se duplican y la reemisión del mismo borrador es idempotente.
La aprobación humana se solicita antes de asignar folio y se registra sin pretender autenticación.
Sin llamadas LLM para matemáticas, acciones externas, envío, ni expedición de CFDI.
qa: Precisión decimal exacta y ROUND_HALF_UP por renglón
Códigos de impuestos configurados y vigentes
Sin duplicidad de folios bajo concurrencia
Idempotencia de emisión y hash de snapshot
Paridad de Word/PDF respecto al JSON
